claims.claim: The item is a PS4 Pro with twice the GPU power of the standard PS4.
claims.evidence: Photos show PlayStation branding but no model text; the identity model is null and the PS4 Pro designation is not visible in any photo.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty and contain no console.
risks.proof: A clip or photo showing the box opened with the console inside.

risks.risk: The console inside may not work.
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on, loading a game, and displaying video output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or untested.

risks.risk: No accessories such as controller, cables, or manuals are included.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories together with the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console only with no accessories.

risks.risk: It may be the digital edition rather than the disc edition.
risks.proof: A close-up of the front label or disc slot showing whether a disc drive is present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lower-value digital edition.

risks.risk: There is no warranty or proof of purchase.
risks.proof: A screenshot or photo of a receipt or warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with no warranty and no proof of purchase.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label on the box to confirm PS4 Pro versus standard PS4.
Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Photo of the opened box showing the console and all contents.
Photo of all included accessories (controller, cables, manuals).
Photo or screenshot of proof of purchase or warranty.
response.reason: The witness identifies PlayStation boxes, so the item can be priced at its worst case; the seller's PS4 Pro claim cannot be confirmed from the photos.
